finalText:
Build's green now, no more errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That crashed the build outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid instead of off, so it would've thrown next.

The rest of the noise — `Buffer()`, `punycode`, loader hook, etc. — is just deprecation chatter from the bumped packages, not errors. Build now finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
